title: A wafer of 486 processors
alt: A round silicon wafer, its surface covered in a grid of small golden rectangles, each one a processor chip, lying in a scratched clear case on a red cloth.
author: Bill Smith
description: Here is a silicon wafer, partly through the process of making a couple hundred 80486 microprocessor chips. The wafer is six inches in diameter. (The red is just a cloth background. The wafer is encased in a molded plastic clamshell. However, due to years of handling, the case has lots of scratches and the wafer has lots of cracks.)
